notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, survey and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 3 simply supported 35-ft bays, W16X67 + C15X33.9 girders, two 1-ton cab cranes, on new welded haunched rib seats welded to the existing W14X90 columns, with the rail, ties, bearings and end stops; the existing columns are checked with their existing load effects and the existing sidewall rod bracing takes the crane longitudinal forces. The paired flat bars on a direct flange saddle do not suit this capped girder (tie sizing ratio flange-tie-flange 1.84 > 1.00 for the estimated tie demands): the tie is the cap tieback angle bolted to the channel cap. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

fabrication.steel: W girder ASTM A992; cap channel and connection plates ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.) with the rail supplier's joint bars and bolts (deferred submittal), bolts pretensioned and re-tightened after 30 and 90 days of operation.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops. Cap: continuous fillet each W top-flange edge, with the end development shown. Full cap bearing contact required. Bearing stiffeners CJP to the W top flange, bottom fitted.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC. Capped girder shop sequence: weld and UT the bearing stiffener CJPs and any under-flange attachments, check the top flange flatness, then fit and weld the cap.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
